[SWS_TcpIp_00203] ⌈For receptions the TcpIp Module shall ignore the protocol
checksum fields of frames with respect to the configuration of the Ethernet Controller
according to the following list:
• for IPv4 frames that have no additional IPv4 option if IPv4 checksum verification
in hardware is enabled, i.e. EthCtrlEnableOffloadChecksumIPv4 is set to
TRUE
• for not fragmented and not IpSec secured ICMP frames that have no additional
IPv4 option or IPv6 header if ICMP checksum verification in hardware is enabled,
i.e. EthCtrlEnableOffloadChecksumICMP is set to TRUE
• for not IpSec secured TCP frames that have no additional IPv4 option or IPv6
header if TCP checksum verification in hardware is enabled, i.e. EthCtrlEn-
ableOffloadChecksumTCP is set to TRUE
• for not fragmented and not IpSec secured UDP frames that have no additional
IPv4 option or IPv6 header if UDP checksum verification in hardware is enabled,
i.e. EthCtrlEnableOffloadChecksumUDP is set to TRUE
In all other cases, the TcpIp module shall treat frames with mismatching checksums
according the related protocol specification.⌋
